name: number-ticker
title: Number Ticker
description: Number that counts up to its value when it scrolls into view, with thousands separators, decimals, and a prefix or suffix.

props.name: value
props.description: Final number. Changing it later counts from the current number to the new one.

props.name: from
props.description: Starting number. Set it higher than value to count down.

props.name: duration
props.description: Length of the count in milliseconds.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for Intl.NumberFormat, such as id-ID for dots as thousands separators.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Text before the number, such as $.

props.name: suffix
props.description: Text after the number, such as % or +.

a11y: Screen readers get the final value from a visually hidden copy; the counting digits are aria-hidden.
An invisible copy of the final value reserves the width, so the layout does not shift while counting.
With reduced motion, the final value is shown right away.

ai.whenToUse: Highlighting a statistic on a landing page or a dashboard card when it comes into view.
rules: Put text size and weight on the parent element; the ticker inherits them
Use prefix and suffix for currency and units instead of writing them next to the component
Use it for a few key numbers, not for every value in a table

id.description: Angka yang berhitung naik ke nilainya saat masuk layar, dengan pemisah ribuan, desimal, serta prefix atau suffix.

props.value: Angka akhir. Kalau diubah kemudian, hitungan berjalan dari angka sekarang ke angka baru.
props.from: Angka awal. Isi lebih besar dari value untuk hitung mundur.
props.decimals: Jumlah angka di belakang koma yang ditampilkan.
props.locale: Locale untuk Intl.NumberFormat, misalnya id-ID agar pemisah ribuan memakai titik.

a11y: Screen reader membaca nilai akhir dari salinan tersembunyi; digit yang berhitung memakai aria-hidden.
Salinan nilai akhir yang tidak terlihat menjaga lebar, jadi tata letak tidak bergeser saat berhitung.
Dengan reduced motion, nilai akhir langsung tampil.

ai.whenToUse: Menonjolkan statistik di landing page atau kartu dashboard saat masuk layar.
rules: Atur ukuran dan ketebalan teks di elemen induk; ticker mewarisinya
Pakai prefix dan suffix untuk mata uang dan satuan, jangan ditulis di samping komponen
Pakai untuk beberapa angka penting, bukan setiap nilai di tabel
